settings.hero_body: Eight companions against a world of color. Follow the shapes, notice the little expressions, and picture the complete collection as one bright accent in your own space.
settings.detail_title: Eight designs, down to the details.
settings.detail_body: Look closely at the embroidered faces, colorful hoods and little brown paws. Every companion brings its own silhouette to the collection you have been picturing.
settings.final_title: Bring the color into your space.
settings.final_body: Choose the complete set and give the whole crew a place together.
settings.moods_title: Eight colors with their own character.
settings.moods_body: Every pictured plush comes in the complete collection.
settings.personality_title: Let the collection set the tone.
settings.personality_body: Keep the crew together against a simple background or mix it into a favorite shelf. The colorful scene in the ad is styling inspiration; you receive the eight plush companions.
settings.hand_note: Eight companions. Every pictured design included.
settings.personality_eyebrow: Let the collection set the tone.
